key_insight: Off-attractor supervision teaches a neural turbulence surrogate how Navier-Stokes dynamics evolve from states the model drifts into, preventing error amplification and long-horizon collapse.
engineering_relevance: For CFD surrogates deployed beyond their training distribution, OAS improves robustness, preserves turbulence statistics, and greatly extends useful rollout time.
method: Select a small set of off-attractor states where the surrogate is likely to fail.
Relabel each selected state with its true future from DNS and supervise the surrogate on these trajectories.
Generate states from surrogate rollouts, targeted attacks, and dynamics-informed perturbations.
evidence_signal: On 128^3 turbulence, OAS raises median time to failure from 21 to 721 steps and achieves the best short-term error and long-horizon statistics among the compared methods.
watch_item: OAS depends on offline DNS relabeling of selected states, so the added cost and choice of attack/selection strategy may affect practicality.
paper_title: Staying on the Attractor: Supervising Neural Surrogates of 3D Turbulence Where They Leave It
